purpose: Freeze and challenge Campaign121's endpoint first-attainment mechanism against all nearby terminal families before any source row or value is read.

candidate.name: intraday_terminal_close_direction_first_attainment_240m
candidate.selected_bar_grid: Exactly 240 continuous-auction bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. The first selected bar's raw open is open_09_31; the ordered raw closes are close_1 through close_240, with close_240 at 15:00. The standalone 09:30 row is loaded only for exact raw-grid validation and excluded from the formula.
candidate.direction_rule: Set d=+1 when close_240>open_09_31, d=-1 when close_240<open_09_31 and d=0 on exact equality. No tolerance, logarithm or return magnitude is used.
candidate.first_attainment_rule: For d=+1, tau is the smallest 1-based i with close_i>=close_240. For d=-1, tau is the smallest i with close_i<=close_240. The terminal close guarantees tau in [1,240]. For d=0 no directional target exists and the score is frozen to zero.
candidate.validity: Require the exact grid, one provider and symbol, and finite strictly positive open_09_31 plus all 240 closes. Exact equality is preserved; no imputation or adjustment is allowed.
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A terminal directional level reached earlier in the completed session is less dependent on a last-minute print and is more consistent with early information acceptance, which may carry from the next open through the third close.

overlap_challenges.reason: The terminal factor averages all 240 close signs relative to a fixed opening reference and discards their order. Campaign121 uses the open only to orient one endogenous terminal-close target, then retains the first passage time. Two paths can have identical open-relative occupation counts yet reach the same terminal level at different minutes.

Extreme-arrival order times the first session high and low. Campaign121 reads no high or low, and its terminal close can be strictly inside the session extremes; fixing high/low arrival order does not fix first passage of the terminal close level.

Terminal close location is a magnitude ratio against the full-session high-low range and contains no clock order. Campaign121 is invariant to high and low changes that preserve open and closes and can change under a permutation of pre-terminal closes that leaves the final close and range location fixed.

Frontier innovation counts repeated close record extensions throughout the path. Campaign121 records exactly one first passage of the realized endpoint target; paths may have the same record count but different terminal-level arrival time, or the same arrival time but different later record counts.

Chord adherence aggregates distance from two fitted endpoint lines and resets at lunch. Campaign121 uses no distance, mean or half-session reset and is determined by one full-session directional first-passage clock.

The terminal factor transforms endpoint net return behavior. Campaign121 discards endpoint displacement magnitude after exact directional orientation and can vary solely by reordering pre-terminal closes.

Campaign120 resets at lunch and parses all adjacent ternary close-direction symbols. Campaign121 uses neither a symbol sequence nor parser: magnitude changes that preserve every adjacent direction can move the terminal-level first passage, while many different direction strings can share the same tau.

Candidate49 counts repeated own-close crossings around a causal amount/volume-weighted moving reference. Campaign121 reads neither amount nor volume, counts one endpoint first passage, and never enters or changes the prospective ledgers.

frozen_counterfactuals: Permuting pre-terminal closes can change tau while preserving the first open, terminal close, daily high-low range and terminal close location.
Changing high, low, volume or amount while preserving the first open and all closes leaves Campaign121 unchanged.
Changing close magnitudes without changing adjacent direction symbols can move the terminal target crossing and therefore change Campaign121 while leaving Campaign120's symbol parser unchanged.
Changing later closes after the first terminal-level passage can alter occupation, chord, frontier and parser summaries while leaving Campaign121 unchanged.
rejected_variants_before_values: last passage, median passage, passage count, recross count, duration beyond target or post-attainment maintenance
high, low, VWAP, previous close, lunch close, volume or amount reference levels
morning-only, afternoon-only, half-reset, late-only, 09:30-inclusive or alternate windows
